data.name: Vinterkyla: Shattered Realms
data.detailed_description:
Vinterkyla: Shattered Realms is a player-driven open-world RPG inspired by Dungeons & Dragons, where the story writes itself through your choices.

In the war-torn world of Elyndor, the alliance between three great kingdoms has shattered. Once ruled by dragons and unity, the lands now simmer with betrayal, broken oaths, and uncertain futures. Amidst this chaos, you create your own path.

⚔️ Be anyone. Start as a prisoner, noble, merchant — even your starting attributes affect your story.
🛡️ Live freely. Own a tavern, become a thief, raise an army, or disappear into the wilderness.
🎲 Shape destiny. Use class-based skills and a dice-based system (D20, D6, D100) for combat, conversations, and consequences.
🌍 Watch the world evolve. NPCs remember you, have children, build empires — or fall into darkness.
🐉 Uncover ancient myths. Explore a vast land haunted by legends, from Fenrir to forgotten dragons.
👫 Play solo or co-op. Team up with friends and carve your story together — or go it alone.

There is no chosen one. No main quest. No path but the one you make.

Will you unite the kingdoms… or rule the ashes?

data.short_description: A dynamic open-world RPG where your background shapes your story. Rule a tavern, lead a rebellion, or vanish into legend. In a world torn by betrayal and war, your choices reshape the fate of three fractured realms.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Swedish, Ukrainian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K eller AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
